input_contract: One rendered PNG or JPEG page per request; not a PDF upload or chat-completions request
selection_basis: The user explicitly requested NVIDIA document AI. Preserve the older Ollama text client as an alternate reuse option, not as proof of this selected document service.
activation_rule: This is a planning target, not a runtime switch or implemented client. Implement BR-DOC-007 and BR-DOC-012, then satisfy gates A/B and the bounded C evaluation prerequisites before any live invocation.
implementation_requirements: Retain original PDF identity, render each permitted page deterministically and bind page images to original page numbers and hashes.
Pin the actual service/model/API versions from the deployed manifest; documentation release does not verify the installed runtime.
Treat finish_reason=length as partial output; finish_reason=stop alone does not prove field or source completeness.
Bound page batches, queue concurrency, rendered image memory, timeouts, retries, output tokens and permitted cost.
Keep provider candidates unreviewed and preserve raw-response hashes, source spans and actual CPU/CUDA/remote execution metadata.
Verify supported hardware and precision before self-hosting; no consumer GPU compatibility or speedup is assumed.
